生息光語

Language of Living Light
閃閃發光設計工作室　戴綺芬 設計
台北　165 m²

Located in the heart of urban Taipei, this 165-square-meter healthy, eco-conscious residence embodies a sustainable design philosophy expressed through the language of light, transforming a fragmented floor plan into a breathing composition of light and shadow.

Through selective demolition, the spatial layout is reconfigured to resolve the plan's irregularities and the profusion of doors, carving out a central daylight axis where light leads and movement follows. Bamboo-wood slatted panels seamlessly integrate five interior doors into a continuous architectural surface, their presence hidden within the natural grain. Mirror walls and softly illuminated display cabinets dissolve the corridor's boundaries, weaving the living, dining and kitchen areas together with the verdant balcony into a single spatial experience.

Custom storage is precisely recessed into the walls, achieving a seamless harmony between aesthetics and utility. Under gentle side lighting, the refined texture of ultra-thin stone veneers quietly reveals its tactile honesty, complemented by the warmth of herringbone wood flooring and a low-saturation palette that allows the materials to speak for themselves.

Rather than mere adornment, greenery is treated as an organic companion, thoughtfully interspersed throughout the home. Interacting with the controllable natural light, the layered planting helps regulate a comfortable indoor microclimate across the seasons.

The bedroom is appointed with negative-ion sleeping textiles, completing a private sanctuary conceived for stillness and quiet resonance. Within this house, a complete, unburdened rest becomes the truest place life comes home to.

台北都會，165 平方公尺健康永續住宅。設計以光為軸線展開，將零碎視覺轉化為會呼吸的光影詩篇。

捨棄多餘牆體以微調原始平面，化解多門的繁雜並理順不方正的餐廚格局；重整後的動線，成為貫穿全室的採光軸線，體現「光線前導，動線隨行」的空間秩序。

竹木格柵完美整合五扇門扉，使立面回歸純粹，將門隱匿於紋理之中。走廊透過鏡面與微光展櫃進行空間消融，無縫串聯客餐廚與綠意陽台，重塑過道的視覺價值。

機能收納精準隱入牆體，達成美學與實用的極致整合。質樸肌理在側光微照下展現層次，人字拼木地板奠定溫潤基調；整體低彩度色系，旨在去除非必要裝飾，讓材料本身發聲。

植栽被賦予日常的陪伴角色，有機地散落於空間各處，成為貼近生活的重要存在。室內綠意與可控自然光相互調節，共同構築舒適的四季微氣候。

臥房引入負離子睡眠用具，讓空間化為支持身心安定、承載和諧共振的寧靜能量場。在這座家屋裡，全然的歇息，是生活最真摯的歸宿。
